run_main_extract_artifacts: run the main function to extract text, tables, images, and charts from a PDF file
extract_from_image: extract structured artifacts from a single image file using LLM inference
extract_from_pdf: extract structured artifacts from all pages of a PDF file using LLM inference
build_inference_request: build an LLM inference request with an image, system prompt, user prompt, and output schema
save_extraction_results: save extracted artifacts to JSON, CSV, Excel, and optionally SQL and vector databases
